title: A category matrix keeps its name, rules and categories after the release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, write down one category matrix's name, its categories and each range's markup.
  • Use the same staging client after the deploy, with no matrix changed since (its Matrices list Audit Log shows no event).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the written-down matrix's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A matrix with the written-down name, letter for letter, is listed.
  • Its Categories column names the same categories as before the deploy.

Step 2:

  • The matrix page's Categories line names the same categories.
  • The grid has the same ranges and markups as written down.
  • The grid shows a Default column and no other tier column.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a matrix set up on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
